name: Levofloxacin
summary: Once-daily respiratory fluoroquinolone with strong pneumococcal activity and near-complete oral bioavailability.
mechanism: Inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase (topoisomerase II) and topoisomerase IV, blocking DNA replication.
pharmacodynamics: Concentration-dependent killing with a post-antibiotic effect.

dosing.adult: 500-750 mg PO/IV once daily (respiratory, skin, urinary infections)

clinicalPearls: Better S. pneumoniae activity than ciprofloxacin — preferred respiratory fluoroquinolone
good: Once-daily respiratory fluoroquinolone with near-complete oral bioavailability.
bad: Same class toxicities as ciprofloxacin; reserve for when safer alternatives are unsuitable.
